pick.headline: UN demands Libya hand over Lockerbie suspects
pick.summary: On 21 January 1992 the UN Security Council adopted Resolution 731, urging Libya to respond to US, British and French requests concerning the bombings of Pan Am 103 and UTA 772.
pick.significance: The two suspects in the Lockerbie bombing were alleged to be Libyan intelligence officers. Libya's refusal led to UN sanctions in March 1992.
